actions.action: Slide the plant out and inspect the roots
If roots are mushy, trim them and repot into fresh airy medium
Check whether the moss is dry to the touch
Flush the medium thoroughly with plain or distilled water, repeated once or twice over a few days
Trim crispy leaf edges with clean scissors
Once new growth appears, feed at quarter strength every 4-6 weeks
Water only when the top of the medium starts to dry

reason: The answer blames the fertilizer and treats poorly draining wet moss only as an alternative. Its repot into airy medium depends on finding root rot, and it never suggests a snug pot, so the actual fix is incomplete. Flushing with drainage checked is unlikely to harm the plant.
